cases.question: Why was the launch date moved?
cases.answer: The launch date was moved from November 3rd to November 17th because the payments integration was behind schedule, specifically the Stripe webhook handling was still dropping events under load, and it would take two weeks to fix it. cases.question: What is the main reason customers are churning?
cases.answer: The main reason customers are churning is missing CSV export, as it's the number one reason mentioned in the churn survey results, and 11 out of 28 churned accounts named it as the main reason [customer-feedback-review, 00:00:39, Sofia].

cases.question: How many support tickets mentioned CSV export last month?
cases.answer: Forty-two tickets last month, and eleven of the twenty-eight churned accounts named it as the main reason. [customer-feedback-review, 00:00:39, Sofia]

cases.question: Who will tell customers that CSV export is coming?
cases.answer: Sofia will send a note to the customers who requested CSV export, telling them it's coming in Q1 [customer-feedback-review, 00:03:01, Priya][customer-feedback-review, 00:03:10, Sofia].

cases.question: What problems have been reported with the bank connection step?
cases.answer: People don't understand the bank connection step and they open chat to ask about it [customer-feedback-review, 00:02:35, Priya]. In usability tests, about half of testers got stuck there [product-launch-planning, 00:05:18, Leo].

cases.question: How is the webhook problem being fixed?
cases.answer: The webhook problem is being fixed with retries with exponential backoff and an idempotency check. [engineering-standup, 00:03:03, Marcus][product-launch-planning, 00:00:38, Marcus]

cases.question: Are there concerns about how fast the mobile app is?
cases.answer: Yes. There are complaints about the mobile app being slow to load the dashboard, but the volume is smaller compared to other issues. [customer-feedback-review, 00:02:41, Sofia]
